interpretation: Window-resolved covariation of the local force-to-observable susceptibility, the local record spread, and the local finite-time Lyapunov stretching along the chaotic attractor, plus log-log response slopes of both quantities against the stretching and two-sample tests of the local Fisher-proxy distribution across flux phases at fixed drive. The matched-Fisher lemma's shared-stretching premise requires signal and noise to be functions of the same local stretching; the reported correlations and slopes quantify how strongly each responds. This is a model-level classical linear-response statement on the tested trajectory ensemble; it is not a quantum, SQL, or device claim.

method.noise: window standard deviation of the record X_a = Re(alpha)
method.response: exact linear response: w' = J(x) w + e_F with e_F = (0,0,0,1,0,0), w reset to zero at every window boundary; S_k = window mean of w_0
method.stretching: QR block accumulators of the tangent flow per window
